items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: we did, you know, stuff with Bing Crosby and Perry Como and all sorts of people.

ctx.x: Yes, it certainly is. You worked the Flip Wilson Show...

I worked for four years with his show. And the reason that he wanted... Nobody had heard this before. Because when I worked with the show, Flip couldn't carry a tune in a basket. George Weill had to stand down in front and pull him in. You know, he'd point, "Come in now," and kind of guide him through these things. And we did, you know, stuff with Bing Crosby and Perry Como and all sorts of people. Flip was very insecure at the time with his singing, but he pulled it off because he's a hard worker. But now he's…
What years were those that you worked with Flip Wilson?
